prompt: `Track.leg_lengths_km()` recomputes every great-circle distance each time it is called, and summarising a track calls it more than once. Cache the leg lengths so that a summary computes each leg's distance only once, without changing any results.
bash_commands: git ls-files; cat $(git ls-files | grep -v -i readme | head -20)
cat README.md; grep -rn "points" src tests | grep -v "track.points\b\|\.points\]" | head -30

cat >> tests/test_track.py <<'EOF'


def test_leg_lengths_are_computed_once_per_summary(make_track, monkeypatch):
    import trailhead.track
    from trailhead.report import summarise

    calls = []
    real = trailhead.track.haversine_km

    def counting(*args):
        calls.append(args)
        return real(*args)

    monkeypatch.setattr(trailhead.track, "haversine_km", counting)
    track = make_track((0, 0, 1000), (0.01, 0.01, 1095), (0.02, 0.02, 1050))
    summarise(track)
    assert len(calls) == 2  # one per leg


def test_leg_lengths_follow_changes_to_the_points(make_track):
    from trailhead.track import Point

    track = make_track((0, 0, 0), (0, 0.01, 0))
    assert track.length_km() == pytest.approx(1.11195, abs=1e-3)
    track.points.append(Point(0, 0.03, 0))
    assert track.length_km() == pytest.approx(3.33585, abs=1e-3)
    track.points[2] = Point(0, 0.02, 0)
    assert track.length_km() == pytest.approx(2.2239, abs=1e-3)
    track.points = [Point(0, 0, 0), Point(0, 0.03, 0)]
    assert track.length_km() == pytest.approx(3.33585, abs=1e-3)
    del track.points[1:]
    assert track.leg_lengths_km() == []


def test_mutating_the_returned_legs_does_not_affect_the_track(make_track):
    track = make_track((0, 0, 0), (0, 0.01, 0))
    track.leg_lengths_km().append(99.0)
    assert track.length_km() == pytest.approx(1.11195, abs=1e-3)
EOF
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; ruff check 2>&1 | tail -3; mypy 2>&1 | tail -2; git stash -q; python -m pytest -q tests/test_track.py 2>&1 | tail -2; git stash pop -q
